name: Solitaire Gold Ring
description: A classic 18k gold-plated band set with a single clear stone. Simple enough for every day, polished enough for an engagement shoot.

name: Twisted Rope Ring
description: A twisted rope band in sterling silver with a smooth inner edge. Stacks well with other rings and stays comfortable all day.

name: Emerald Cut Ring
description: A rectangular green stone framed in gold-plated silver. A bold statement piece that works with both formal and casual outfits.

name: Midnight Signet Ring
description: A flat-top signet ring in blackened silver with a brushed finish. Unisex sizing, available to engrave on request.

name: Pearl Drop Necklace
description: A single freshwater pearl on a fine 45 cm gold-plated chain. A quiet, elegant piece for weddings, work and everything between.

name: Layered Chain Necklace
description: Three fine chains of different lengths joined at one clasp, so the layered look sits right without tangling.

name: Moonstone Pendant
description: A polished moonstone in a sterling silver setting on an adjustable chain. The stone shifts from pale blue to white in the light.

name: Gold Hoop Earrings
description: Lightweight 30 mm hoops in 18k gold plating with a secure hinged clasp. Light enough to wear from morning to night.

name: Crystal Stud Earrings
description: Small round crystal studs on hypoallergenic posts. A sparkle that works at the office and at a night out.

name: Tassel Drop Earrings
description: Fine gold-plated chain tassels that move with you. Lightweight and long, they frame the face without pulling on the ear.

name: Cuban Link Bracelet
description: A chunky Cuban link bracelet in sterling silver with a lobster clasp. Heavy enough to feel solid, smooth enough to wear daily.

name: Beaded Charm Bracelet
description: Hand-strung glass beads with a small gold-plated charm and a stretch fit. Easy to put on, easy to layer with a watch.
